repairability_aware_visual_policy.policy_purpose: Enforce repairability-aware quality assessment for all visual outputs

repairable_with_validated_tools.description: Defects that can be fixed using known, validated tools/nodes
repairable_with_validated_tools.action: Allow with repair plan, track repair execution

not_repairable_with_current_tools.description: Defects that cannot be fixed with current available tools
not_repairable_with_current_tools.action: BLOCK - must regenerate with corrected approach

unknown_repairability.description: Defects whose repairability is not yet known
examples: Novel defect type not in taxonomy
unknown_repairability.action: BLOCK - must assess repairability before proceeding

operator_review_required.description: Defects requiring human visual expert judgment
operator_review_required.action: Route to visual expert review, then operator decision

generation_recipe_must_change.description: Defects indicating fundamental generation approach failure
generation_recipe_must_change.action: BLOCK - must revise generation recipe (prompt, workflow, models)

repairability_assessment_workflow.step_1: QA identifies defects using universal canon and defect taxonomy
repairability_assessment_workflow.step_2: QA checks defect_repairability_matrix for known repairability
repairability_assessment_workflow.step_3: If repairability known, route accordingly (repair or block)
repairability_assessment_workflow.step_4: If repairability unknown, BLOCK until assessment complete
repairability_assessment_workflow.step_5: Visual expert review for ambiguous cases
repairability_assessment_workflow.step_6: Operator final decision on acceptance or rejection
